tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace text in a file. old_string must match exactly, including whitespace, and only once unless replace_all is set; include surrounding lines to make it unique. Read the file first.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files by name pattern, such as "**/*.go" or "src/*.json". `**` matches any number of directories, and a pattern without a slash matches file names at any depth. Results are sorted paths.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a regular expression. Prints matching lines as path:line:text. Filter files with glob, such as "*.go".

tools.name: python
tools.description: Run a Python script with /Users/aurimas/.pyenv/shims/python3, given as code or as a file path, in workspace/. Returns the exit code, stdout and stderr, and for an uncaught exception its type, message and traceback with file and line. Prefer this to running python through the shell. Times out like the shell tool; a script is never run again automatically.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file. Lines come numbered; read a large file in parts with offset and limit. Relative paths are relative to workspace/.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a command with /bin/bash in workspace/ and return its exit code, stdout and stderr. Each call starts in workspace/ with a fresh shell. Commands run until they exit or time out (default 2m0s, at most 10m0s); output is capped at 32 KiB per stream. A command is never run again automatically.

tools.name: spawn_subagent
tools.description: start a subagent on a subtask

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Missing directories are created. inputs/ is read-only; put deliverables in output/.
